frontmatter.title: S2.4 Aligning Security with Development
when_to_use: integrating security into development using engineering terminology
empowering developers to address security confidently
calibrating mindset expectations between security and development
engaging AppSec early in requirements and design
threats: imposing security-centric jargon that disrupts development
expecting developers to adopt adversarial mindsets as primary defense
AppSec engaging too late in the SDLC to add value
frontmatter.summary: Security and development are complementary disciplines. True alignment uses established software engineering terms and engages AppSec early (Participation over Assessment).
